item.title: WILLIAM BENNETT, ROB NOEL: Two years after Columbia encampment, campuses still chilled by fear
item.summary: The Columbia University Gaza solidarity encampment arrests sparked a campus crisis, and FIRE data shows self-censorship among students keeps growing.

item.title: Clarence Thomas warns America: liberty dies when we choose comfort over courage
item.summary: Justice Clarence Thomas delivers a stirring speech at UT Austin calling Americans to defend the ideals of the Declaration of Independence daily.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Trump taps former deputy surgeon general to helm CDC
item.summary: President Trump announced former deputy surgeon general Dr. Erica Schwartz as his nominee for Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) director.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Starmer and Macron accused of ‘playing at being relevant’ with Strait of Hormuz plan
item.summary: Britain and France push a European-led naval mission to safeguard shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, separate from U.S. military operations in the region.

item.title: WWE Hall of Fame 2026 class features Stephanie McMahon, AJ Styles and Dennis Rodman among inductees
item.summary: WWE inducts its star-studded Hall of Fame class of 2026 at Dolby Live in Las Vegas, featuring AJ Styles, Stephanie McMahon and Dennis Rodman.

item.title: Singer D4vd arrested and held without bail in case tied to teen found dead in Tesla: Police
item.summary: Singer D4vd, whose real name is David Burke, was arrested in connection with the murder of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez in LA, LAPD says.

item.title: Greenland talks on ‘good trajectory,’ White House says amid Trump takeover push
item.summary: U.S. officials say negotiations with Denmark and Greenland are moving in a positive direction, even as tensions remain over Trump’s push for greater U.S. control of the strategic Arctic island.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Airport lounge chaos goes viral as kids run wild and passengers ditch basic etiquette
item.summary: Once-exclusive airport lounges are now packed with credit card holders, leading to reported food raids, chaos and heated etiquette debates online. Experts weighed in.

item.title: GREGG JARRETT: Long-hidden documents reveal first Trump impeachment was a total fraud
item.summary: Newly declassified documents show the first Trump impeachment was orchestrated fraud, DNI Tulsi Gabbard says, sending criminal referrals to the DOJ.

item.title: Michele Tafoya on NFL-New York Times dust up, future of journalism
item.summary: Former Sunday Night Football reporter Michele Tafoya offers a stark assessment of journalism's decline in a new podcast interview about media trust.
